(SUPPLIER- FINECROME SHAFTS Pvt. Ltd. Mumbai)"}],"comment":"The title block specifies the material as \"M.S.\" (mild steel), but note N1 requires \"En-8(D)\" medium-carbon steel, which is a different material. This conflict will cause confusion in procurement and manufacturing. The designer should update the title-block material field to match note N1.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block material from \"M.S.\" to \"En-8(D)\" or remove the conflicting reference in N1."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"2) # USE STD. Ø20g6 En-8(D) BRIGHT BAR. (SUPPLIER- FINECROME SHAFTS Pvt. Ltd. Mumbai)"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $ FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS, HARDNESS 850 TO 1000 HV."}],"comment":"Note N1 calls out a Ø20g6 fit (an ISO fit with a tolerance band of 0.013 mm) and note N4 specifies hard chrome plating of 15 to 20 microns, but no allowance is made for the plating thickness on this tight fit. Without accounting for the plating buildup, the shaft will be oversized after coating and will not assemble into its mating hole. The designer should specify that the g6 dimension applies after plating, or provide an undersize pre-plating dimension that accommodates the 15–20 micron coating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the Ø20g6 tolerance applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate machining dimension to allow for the 15–20 micron chrome thickness."}]}
